people.name: Courtney Epps
sources: Courtney Epps public biography, education and introductory session
people.profile: OTB Tax identifies Courtney Epps as its founder, tax strategist, author and speaker. The public site connects her education platform with an accounting and tax service business.
people.offering: The site describes accounting, payroll and tax services alongside strategy sessions, books, courses and events. Compare the initial session with the complete professional engagement.
people.scenario: You discovered a home-business deduction video and need your business books, payroll and tax filings coordinated. Ask what the initial session produces and which later services require another agreement.
questions: What written deliverable does the initial strategy session provide?
Which accounting, payroll and returns are included in the full proposal?
Who implements recommendations and checks eligibility?
What continuing support, renewals and additional fees apply?
people.boundary: A preliminary session and an education purchase do not establish an all-inclusive planning, implementation or filing contract. Ask the assigned team to document the scope and evaluate your facts; no marketed savings are adopted as a guaranteed result.
people.fee: The reviewed homepage advertises a $99 tax strategy session. That introductory session price is not a quote for a complete ongoing accounting, planning and filing engagement. Confirm current availability and subsequent fees.

people.name: Andrew Poulos
sources: Poulos Accounting public services and media work
Andrew Poulos biography, education and professional role
people.profile: Poulos Accounting identifies Andrew Poulos as an enrolled agent, author, speaker and host of Financial Smarts Network. Its team page describes his public tax and financial education work.
people.offering: The firm describes bookkeeping, payroll, preparation, business consulting and IRS audit and collection representation. These are separate tasks that should be assigned in the engagement.
people.scenario: You saw a tax segment and have both current business returns and a payroll tax notice. Compare forward planning, compliance and representation with their own deadlines and deliverables.
questions: Who reviews the notice and takes responsibility for the response deadline?
Which current returns and bookkeeping tasks are included?
Is audit or collection representation a separate agreement?
Who performs the work and how are fees and additional scope charged?
people.boundary: A media appearance or educational course does not establish personal access to Andrew or a representation engagement. Confirm the assigned professional, authorization and actual notice scope before changing providers.
people.fee: The reviewed homepage and team biography do not establish a universal fixed project fee. Request separate written pricing for accounting, preparation, planning and any IRS representation.

people.name: Eric Green
sources: Eric Green public speaking, books and podcast
Practitioner membership tiers and price evidence
people.profile: Eric Green’s official platform describes a tax attorney, author, speaker and Tax Rep Network podcast host. Tax Rep Network identifies his separate role as a Green & Sklarz partner.
people.offering: Tax Rep Network provides training, software, practitioner resources and case support for tax professionals. A taxpayer legal representation matter requires a separate engagement with the actual legal provider.
people.scenario: You need help with an IRS collection matter after hearing a podcast. First determine whether you are a practitioner buying case support or a taxpayer seeking representation; those are different contracts.
questions: Am I buying practitioner education or taxpayer representation?
Which entity and professional accept my actual matter?
What notice, audit, collection or litigation tasks are covered?
Which membership, legal, expert or additional fees apply?
people.boundary: Professional membership and case support do not automatically make the subscriber’s client Eric’s legal client. AE’s general advisory scope also should not be treated as a substitute for criminal tax counsel or litigation.
people.fee: The membership page lists Essential at $37/month and Professional at $399/month. Its Accelerator card shows $1,500/month while the FAQ asks buyers to contact the team for details; confirm that premium program’s current terms. None of these is a taxpayer legal representation quote.

people.name: Dominique Molina
people.brand: American Institute of Certified Tax Planners
sources: Dominique Molina official biography and education platforms
people.profile: AICTP identifies Dominique Molina as its co-founder and president, a speaker and author. Her biography describes professional training and educational publishing through Think Outside The Tax Box and MidasIQ.
people.offering: The site offers tax-planning education and certification plus routes to find a tax planner. A member’s professional engagement is distinct from buying education or receiving a directory introduction.
people.scenario: You follow proactive planning content and want to engage a planner. Separate the training organization, publication subscription and actual firm that will review your business records.
questions: Is this professional education, a publication or a client engagement?
Who is the contracting planner and assigned professional?
Which implementation tasks and affected returns are included?
What training, membership and client-service fees are separate?
people.boundary: A private training or certification program is not proof of a government license, personal service access or a particular tax outcome. Confirm the actual professional’s credentials and engagement; the biography does not establish current private-client availability with Dominique.
people.fee: The reviewed biography does not establish a fixed taxpayer-service fee. Request current pricing for the specific education product and a separate written proposal from the engaged planner.

people.name: Ed Slott
sources: Official Ed Slott author and educator biography
Advisor directory terms and responsibility distinction
people.profile: Ed Slott and Company describes Ed Slott as a CPA, retirement tax educator, author and public speaker. His platform includes IRA education and an advisor-training network.
people.offering: The company describes education for consumers and financial professionals and says it neither sells nor endorses a particular financial product. Its advisor directory introduces separate advisors whose services require their own review and engagement.
people.scenario: You watched retirement tax education and want a Roth conversion analysis connected to your business income. Compare educational resources with a named advisor’s projection, implementation and filing responsibilities.
questions: Who contracts for my personal retirement tax analysis?
Is the purchase education, advisor training or a professional service?
Who coordinates tax projections, custodian instructions and filing?
Are investment management, insurance or other product fees separate?
people.boundary: An advisor-directory listing is not an engagement with Ed Slott. The directory terms disclaim responsibility for listed advisors’ services. AE’s defined tax advisory is not a substitute for custody, investment management or complete retirement financial planning.
people.fee: The reviewed biography, company overview and directory terms do not establish a universal private-client tax planning fee. Price education and any separately engaged advisor services on their own terms.

pairs: Compare an introductory strategy session with a complete business advisory and filing proposal. Ask for the same bookkeeping, payroll, implementation and returns before comparing total fees.

Compare taxpayer accounting and representation with practitioner training and legal representation supplied under a separate contract. Identify who owns the notice deadline and actual taxpayer matter.

A taxpayer with a collection problem should compare the engaged representation provider, not a professional education membership against a resolution fee. Ask which entity accepts the case and which stages are included.
Compare professional planning education, credentials, software and publications by their intended buyer. An advisor tool or training purchase does not itself create a taxpayer engagement.
Compare retirement tax education and advisor introductions with a broader personal CFO or wealth relationship. Separate tax analysis, portfolio work, custody and filing in the actual proposal.
selection: Five absent identities confirmed against the 34-creator inventory and compare routes. Official public education, media and service sources; no search-volume ranking.
